cohort: Children who were either exposed or not exposed to intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis.
finding: Exposure to intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis was associated with an increased childhood body mass index (BMI) that persisted until age 10 years.
mod_finding: Children born via caesarean section with intrapartum antibiotic exposure had a higher increase in BMI (0.40 kg/m2) at 10 years compared to those born via vaginal delivery (0.14 kg/m2).
